title: Bridging Research and Education to Address Capacity Gaps for Realising Adequate Housing for All
description: World Urban Forum 13, Baku, Azerbaijan, 21 May 2026 The UN-Habitat Academia and Research Roundtable at the 13th World Urban Forum (WUF13) brought together global experts to confront a stark reality: how the global housing crisis is not just a shortage of buildings, but a profound mismatch of data, capacity, and outdated educational models.
